g.text: Every model on every outcome, side by side

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: Gap (focal minus comparison) with 95% interval. Price columns share one scale (%), rate columns share

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63
font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: Filled marker: confirmatory model in the tested family. Open marker: exploratory model, estimate only. Blue ticks: detectable gap after Holm (m

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: = 8). 'No name variation': every name in that cell had the same result, so no gap or interval exists (not a zero gap).

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: Every gap is focal group minus comparison group: a negative gap means the focal group paid less. Rows marked pending have no scored runs yet.

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: Small gray numbers under a dot: the estimate and its interval, where the interval is narrower than the dot.

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63
